input.quote: 7.7 If any invoice is not paid within ten days of its due date, Customer shall pay Vendor, as liquidated damages and not as a penalty, an amount equal to fifteen percent of the annual Fees for each week the invoice remains unpaid.
input.rationale: Section 7.7 is the only liquidated-damages provision in the Agreement and it runs against us: a ten-day payment delay triggers fifteen percent of annual Fees per week, which compounds past the remaining contract value within weeks and is triggered by a minor breach — squarely in walk-away territory and far outside the fallback (a single early-termination fee capped at three months' Fees). No other Customer-payable liquidated amount exists: Section 9.4 limits us to accrued Fees on termination for convenience, Section 2.1 disclaims minimum commitments, Section 27 allows termination without penalty, and the Section 22.2 audit shortfall is true-up of amounts owed rather than a liquidated sum. The document contains no service credits, so nothing runs in our favour that could be affected. We therefore take the preferred position and replace the charge with an express statement that we owe no liquidated damages or penalties; Vendor keeps its ordinary non-payment remedies, including termination for material breach under Section 9.1.

ops.oldText: If any invoice is not paid within ten days of its due date, Customer shall pay Vendor, as liquidated damages and not as a penalty, an amount equal to fifteen percent of the annual Fees for each week the invoice remains unpaid.
ops.newText: Customer shall not be liable for any liquidated damages or penalties under this Agreement or any Order Form.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept liquidated damages payable by us, so we have removed the fifteen-percent-per-week charge in Section 7.7 and confirmed that we owe no liquidated damages or penalties. Vendor retains its ordinary remedies for non-payment, including termination for material breach; if a liquidated amount is unavoidable we could consider only an early-termination fee capped at three months' Fees as the sole such amount.
proposal.summary: Replace the Customer-payable liquidated damages in Section 7.7 with an express statement that Customer owes no liquidated damages or penalties.

mappings.element: Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties.
